text.en: Pet owners frequently praise team members Jae, Jaydn, and Ashley for their friendly reception and attentive care. Reviewers note that stylists listen closely to grooming specifications and ensure both clients and pets feel welcome. While one customer reported frustration over an unexpected appointment delay, feedback reflects a dedicated, responsive staff.

title.en: Attractive styling and custom bakery items

text.en: Clients report high satisfaction with the grooming results, noting that dogs leave looking neatly trimmed and well brushed. Reviewers also praise unique specialty offerings such as custom celebration cakes and cupcakes crafted for pet milestones. Multiple dog owners mention returning regularly due to the reliable standard of washing and styling.

Pet parents appreciate the gentle treatment given to their dogs, observing that animals remain relaxed and happy throughout visits. Reviewers whose pets underwent their very first salon experience highlight that the calm handling prevented anxiety. Clients describe feeling reassured when entrusting both energetic breeds and small dogs to the groomers.

q.en: Does Paws On Central offer custom pet bakery goods?

a.en: Yes, clients confirm that the shop bakes custom celebratory pet cakes and pupcakes decorated with tailored messaging.

q.en: Are self-wash facilities available on Central Avenue?

a.en: Yes, the salon provides dedicated self-service dog wash stations alongside full-service professional styling packages.

q.en: How do groomers handle puppies experiencing their first groom?

a.en: Reviewers note that stylists introduce puppies to the salon gently, keeping the grooming experience calm and positive.
